newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end quiet day weaker.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end quiet day weaker.

text.p: Yen-based aluminium futures on the Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) closed lower on Friday, pressured down by the yen's firmness and technical selling from local investors, traders said.
Technical selling capped the topside throughout the day, following gains on Thursday which were triggered by the sharp rise in the dollar against the yen, traders said.
The TOCOM benchmark April 1998 contract ended 1.3 yen per kilogram weaker at 190.4 yen. Estimated volume remained thin at 1,047 lots, against 1,664 lots on Thursday.
In London overnight, benchmark three-month aluminium fell by $8 to finish at $1,615 per tonne.
